title: Divine Intervention and Joshua's Victory
english: To God, so that He might not let the day pass by nature, having stopped the sun at Gibeon and the moon at the valley of Aijalon (Joshua 10:12-13). And God stopped the sun and the moon until he struck down the enemies in the midday.

But Jesus the son of Nun, finding the five kings of the nations hiding, fallen into a cave upon the earth, commanded that they be thrown, and having made them be trampled by the people upon the neck, he killed them (Joshua 10:25-27); and having hung their bodies on wood, he later shut them into the cave.
